description: This file contains SQL migration scripts for setting up schemas, tables, functions, indexes, triggers, and security policies in a PostgreSQL database used by a documentation platform. It defines user profiles, document storage, access controls, versioning, and view tracking, tailored for a Supabase backend.

methods.name: public.set_updated_at
methods.description: Trigger function to automatically update the 'updated_at' timestamp on row modifications in relevant tables.

methods.name: public.is_admin
methods.description: Function to check if the current authenticated user has an 'admin' role in the 'public.profiles' table.

methods.name: public.increment_document_view_count
methods.description: Function to atomically increment the 'view_count' for a document whenever it is viewed.
